question: Does a hard systemd cgroup limit contain an induced evaluation-worker OOM while Codex and its caller remain alive?
scope: CPU-only systemd containment regression; no model, inference server, build, benchmark, or GPU use.
stimulus: Start a disposable Python worker and child, then touch 512 MiB inside the 128 MiB unit.
acceptance: systemd reports Result=oom-kill for only the test unit
the worker cgroup records oom_kill and memory.oom.group=1
the invoking tool process and Codex ChatGPT/app-server PIDs remain alive
the parent can write a complete receipt after the worker is gone
stop_rule: If any property is unsupported or any parent/Codex PID disappears, do not start Q35 inference; preserve the failure receipt and investigate.
